verdict.rationale: GitHub README explicitly points to an 'upgrade guide' for migrating projects between versions, confirming a dedicated migration resource exists, but the evidence pack lacks details on its scope (e.g., major version breaking changes, automated schematics, deprecations) or any hands-on confirmation of its effectiveness. Missing for 10: detailed content/coverage of the upgrade guide, independent developer accounts of using it for major-version migrations, and evidence of automated migration tooling (ng update).
